info.title: SecureCloud API
info.description:
SecureCloud is a secure private cloud storage and file management system.
It provides authenticated access to file metadata and file operations.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or credentials are invalid.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not permitted to perform this operation.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing data or an idempotency key.

NotAcceptable.description: Requested response representation is not supported.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns an authentication response.

Uploads a physical file using multipart/form-data.
The server validates the actual file type, calculates a SHA-256
checksum, and creates the file metadata.

413.description: Uploaded file exceeds the permitted size.

get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of files belonging to the
authenticated user. JSON and XML representations are supported
according to the Accept header.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of files to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous page.

schema.description: XML representation of the file list.

post.description:
Creates file metadata for the authenticated user.
This endpoint does not upload file bytes.
The Idempotency-Key makes retries safe when the same key and
request payload are reused.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for this metadata-creation operation.

200.description: Metadata creation result or an idempotent replay, if returned by the service.

get.description:
Returns metadata for a file owned by the authenticated user.
Supports ETag-based conditional requests and JSON/XML negotiation.

schema.description: XML representation of the file metadata.

304.description: File metadata has not changed. No response body is returned.

delete.description: Deletes the stored file and its database metadata.

get.description: Downloads the stored file owned by the authenticated user.

Recalculates the SHA-256 checksum of the stored file and compares
it with the saved checksum.
